notes: Source assets from recovered native bundles. No synthetic notes or imagery.
MIDI beat times and note durations are exact tick/PPQN ratios; rounded only by JSON numeric serialization.
MIDI tempo events retained as provenance; live scene tempo comes from Scheme defaults.
All notes retained; inLoop indicates the source loop window. Do not trigger notes outside it.
Program values are raw zero-based MIDI values; null means no explicit native program change.
OriginalPath is relative to the selected app application resources, not a public download URL.
